agent.label: Agent permissions
agent.description: What this role can do inside each agent it has access to. These actions apply per agent — picked from the Agent Access list above.

account.label: Account permissions
account.description: Shared, account-wide tools and settings. These apply once across every agent and are managed from the Settings menu.

setup.label: Setup
setup.description: Edit the agent itself — personality, models, widget, embed.

channels.label: Channels
channels.description: Connect the agent to messaging apps.

sources.label: Sources
sources.description: Manage the training data the agent learns from.

chat.label: Chat
chat.description: Read, take over, export, or delete live conversations.

audit.label: Audit
audit.description: View the tool-call audit log (tools, connectors, approvals).

evals.label: Evals
evals.description: Test the agent against a suite and track pass-rate over time.

guardrails.label: Guardrails
guardrails.description: AI-safety guards: PII, prompt-injection, blocked topics, toxicity.

analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.description: Inspect usage, sentiment, tone, topics, and source performance.

topics.label: Topics
topics.description: Curate the topics conversations are grouped under.

leads.label: Leads
leads.description: See, configure, and export leads captured by the agent.

administration.label: Administration
administration.description: Owner-style per-agent tasks — chatters and signing secret.

security.label: Security
security.description: Personal credentials used to call the public API.

integrations.label: Integrations
integrations.description: Connect third-party services and custom webhook functions, then attach them to any agent.

library.label: Library
library.description: Reusable prompts shared across the account.

people.label: People
people.description: Manage the chatters granted access to your agents.

governance.label: Governance
governance.description: Audit and control every action your agents take through tools and connectors.

agents_access_all.label: Access all agents
